title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Verification… (CVE-2026-91898)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 have a vulnerability involving improper verification of cryptographic signatures. This flaw could allow an unauthenticated attacker with adjacent network access to execute arbitrary code and elevate privileges on the affected system.
